policy.required_receipt_rule: Only a source-pinned terminal receipt carrying the required native, broker, execution, and teardown fields may enter REAL_BROKER_RECEIPT or ACTUAL_BINARY_RECEIPT state.
policy.unknown_rule: A missing identity, version, capability, command, terminal result, or immutable provenance field remains UNKNOWN or BLOCKED and never defaults to supported.
policy.scope_rule: This packet inventories current source and routes executable work; it neither executes nor substitutes for K2, K4, K12, K13, K14.1, or K15 evidence.

fixture_scope_derivation.rule_a: Take every exact path from the K0.3 authority artifact at .test_declaration_groups[].path.
fixture_scope_derivation.rule_b: From .search_scope.baseline_occurrence_paths[], take paths rooted at tests/, fuzz/, conformance/, or scripts/ whose case-insensitive path contains kafka or record_batch.
fixture_scope_derivation.rule_c: Add exactly six anchors: conformance/src/lib.rs, artifacts/dependency_real_service_fixture_matrix_v1.json, docs/dependency_real_service_fixtures.md, tests/dependency_real_service_fixture_contract.rs, .github/no_mock_policy.json, and artifacts/adapter_certification_matrix_v1.json.
fixture_scope_derivation.normalization: Take the bytewise sorted unique union and serialize each path as UTF-8 followed by one LF.
fixture_scope_derivation.authority_anchor_exclusion: artifacts/kafka_downstream_user_journey_inventory_v1.json is a direct authority pin but is not a fixture path.
fixture_scope_derivation.inherited_pin_join: A fixture path already present in K0.3 source_pins inherits that exact pin by path and must fail closed if the current bytes no longer match.
fixture_scope_derivation.direct_pin_join: A fixture path absent from K0.3 source_pins must resolve to exactly one direct_source_pins row by path; the K0.3 authority anchor is the sole direct pin intentionally outside fixture_paths.
fixture_scope_derivation.duplicate_rule: No path may resolve to more than one direct pin or more than one fixture-path entry.
fixture_scope_derivation.missing_rule: Any fixture path without an inherited or direct pin is UNKNOWN and blocks freshness admission.
